title: Traffic Policy parity deepening (QoS interface assignment)
acceptance_criteria: `/network/traffic-policy` supports CRUD for `qos interface <if> ingress|egress` assignments.
Save path emits diff-based set/delete operations for interface assignments with scoped qos tree commands.
Ingress choices are validated against limiter policy names and egress choices against known QoS policy names.
Validation passes: backend test_app, frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
assumptions: Existing `/vyos/qos` wrapper endpoints remain sufficient for interface assignment operations.
Interface discovery sources may be partially populated; merged source list is used for selector resilience.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added qos interface assignment state parsing, editor UI, validation, and diff-based save generation.
No backend changes required; existing qos tree wrapper already supports command scope.
Validated via backend pytest, frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and UI smoke.
Manual review completed in-session; no blocking issues found.
